auth.login_subtitle: Log in with your email and PIN

auth.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

home.all_done_sub: Review what you learned while more content arrives

retos.title: Challenges & goals
retos.shield_body: Saves your streak on a day you miss the goal.
retos.nothing_yet_body: Start today's lesson and the challenges take care of themselves

test.hint: Pick the one that sounds right. Wrong answers don't count against you.
test.banner_body: Take the placement test and start where you belong, not from zero.

tutor.title: Parlo Tutor
tutor.subtitle: Speak, write and learn with AI
tutor.empty_body: Write anything or pick a situation. I'll correct you and explain in Spanish.
tutor.error: Something went wrong with the tutor. Please try again.
starters: Hi! I want to practice ordering coffee ☕
Let's do a job interview in English 💼

practica.title: Conversation with corrections
practica.subtitle: Talk like in real life. If you slip up, I correct you before moving on and explain why.
practica.goal_cafe: Order a coffee and something to eat
practica.goal_intro: Name, where you're from, what you do
practica.goal_travel: Check in and ask about luggage
practica.goal_flat: Ask about the rent and the area
practica.privacy: Your messages are sent to the AI to be corrected. We don't store the conversation.

escucha.title: Fill in what you hear
escucha.subtitle: Listen to the sentence and fill the gaps. Replay it as many times as you like.
escucha.note: Original Parlo content, read with your device's voice. You can change the voice in your profile.
escucha.solution: Listen again with the answer in front of you

canciones.title: Learn with music
canciones.subtitle: Listen to a song and fill in the gaps. The video pauses on every line.
canciones.add_body: Paste the YouTube link and its lyrics
canciones.video_error: The video couldn't load. Try another link.
canciones.legal: The bundled catalogue is traditional public-domain songs. Anything you add is stored on this device only and never shared.
canciones.f_note: Stored on your device only, for your personal practice.
canciones.err_lyrics: Paste at least one line of lyrics.

perfil.voice_none: Your browser has no English voices installed.
perfil.voice_hint: Only basic voices are installed. You can download a better English voice in your system settings.

repaso.empty_body: Complete lessons and your spaced review will show up here when it's due.
